# CANDIDATE: VIX1D_SPIKE_FADE

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A short-term VIX1D spike above its own EMA20 (by 10%) while SPY exhibits bullish alignment (price > VWAP, EMA5 > EMA8 > EMA13) predicts mean-reversion in the index. This edge exists because VIX1D spikes often reflect transient fear imbalances that revert when the underlying trend remains intact, offering a short opportunity with defined risk.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** When VIX1D > VIX1D_EMA20 * 1.10 AND SPY close > VWAP AND EMA5 > EMA8 > EMA13 (bullish ribbon) AND time between 09:45-10:30 EST, enter short at the next bar open.  
**Exit:**  
- Primary stop: Chart-stop at the most recent swing high (prior higher high)  
- Profit target 1: 1.0R (risk-reward of 1:1 from entry to stop)  
- Runner: Trail stop at 12% below the highest-since-entry price (HWM)  
**Regime filters:** Avoid when VIX1D >= 30 (extreme volatility) or intraday ADX >= 20 (strong trend); avoid first 15 min and last 30 min of session.
